reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
진짜 너뮤 이뻐요ㅜㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ 
가둘40 등길이 30인 강쥐인데 평소 옷사이즈 L사는데 
이건 저희 아가랑 비슷한 스펙인 모델 댕댕이가 M 입었다길래 M사이즈 구매했는데 딱 맞고 
진자 걍 말모... 개이쁨니다... 🩵
제발 사지말아주세효... 저희 댕댕이만 입힐래용.... 😭
reviews.content_en: It's seriously so pretty!!! 😭😭😭 My pup has a chest circumference of 40cm and back length of 30cm, and I usually buy size L, but since a model dog with similar specs wore a size M, I got an M and it fits perfectly. Honestly, I don't even know what to say... it's just so cute... 🩵 Please don't buy it... I only want my pup to wear this.... 😭

reviews.name: 최****
reviews.content:
베이지색 리뷰가 없어서 고민하다가 주문했는데 아주 좋은 선택이었어용!! 5kg대 말티푸 갱얼쥐 넉넉하게 잘 맞았습니다!

가슴둘레 37~38정도인데 하네스 착용 안했을때 여유가 있어서 하네스 착용하고 입히면 딱 좋을 것 같아요! 등길이가 길어서 항상 30까지 여유있게 사는 편인데 딱맞쟈냐?!!너무 귀엽쟈냐?!!

SSFW 포인트 배색 되어있는것도 너무 귀엽구요..진짜 안입은듯 가벼워서 햇빛 쨍쨍한날 피부 보호할 수 있어서 너무 좋을것 같아요! 그리고 하네스 홈부분 파여있어서 야외에서 입고 벗기기 편할 것 같아요ㅎㅎ가벼운 여름옷 찾으시면 추천!!
reviews.content_en: I was hesitant because there were no beige reviews, but I ordered it and it was such a great choice!! My 5kg Maltipoo pup fits perfectly and comfortably! With a chest circumference of about 37-38cm, there's plenty of room without the harness, so it should fit perfectly once the harness is on! The back length is long, so I usually buy up to 30 with extra room, but does it fit perfectly?!! Is it too cute?!! The SSFW point color blocking is super adorable too.. it's so light that it feels like she's not even wearing anything, which is great for protecting her skin on sunny days! And there are cutouts in the harness section, making it convenient to put on and take off outdoors ㅎㅎ Highly recommend if you're looking for a lightweight summer outfit!!

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
강아지 몸무게 3.5-3.6
강아지 평소 옷사이즈 M or L(타이트하게 나온 옷의 경우)

#SSFW 옷의 장점
극강의 세심함! (모자와 등부분에 똑딱이 단추를 수놓아서 모자가 덜컹이지 않고 딱 옷에 고정되어 핏을 흐트러뜨리지 않는 세심한 배려-🫶🏼)
깔끔한 디자인!
(색상이 무엇보다 무조건적으로 튀지않아서 좋아요! 은은한 톤으로 만들어진 색상도 좋고~ 군더더기없는 깔끔한 디자인도 만족스러워요~) 
무엇보다 좋은 것은, 가벼운 소재의 옷 재질!
(사각거리는 소재의 옷이라 물을 적셔도 시원함이 오래 유지되고, 더울때 옷을 적셔놓고 입히면 덜 더워하는데 그렇게 입히면 옷이 무게가 더해질 수 있지만, 이 소재는 기본적으로 가볍기 때문에 변화가 없어서 좋다-☝🏻)
마감 퀄리티👍👍

#SSFW 옷의 아쉬운 점
옷이 얇아서 가볍고 좋지만, 옆구리쪽 똑딱이 단추로 힘줘서 당기면 손상이 갈까봐 살짝 염려됩니당 ㅎ

#체험단 당첨 
좋은 브랜드의 옷을 당첨받아서 매우 기분좋고 설렜어요~!
우리 똥강아지가 이 브랜드의 옷을 입으면 불편해하지 않아서
입힐때마다 만족도가 상당히 높았었는데 이렇게 좋은 기회를 얻게 되어 리뷰할 수 있어서 더욱 더 진심으로 참여하게 되었어요~🤗 그래서인지 리뷰참여 자체가 부담되지 않아서 좋았어요~!
reviews.content_en:
Dog weight: 3.5-3.6kg
Dog's usual size: M or L (for tighter-fitting clothes)

#SSFW Clothing Advantages
Incredible attention to detail! (Snaps are embroidered on the hat and back so the hat doesn't rattle and stays perfectly fixed to the outfit without disrupting the fit - 🫶🏼)
Clean design!
(The colors are great because they're never too bold! The subtle tones are nice, and I'm satisfied with the uncluttered, clean design~)
Most importantly, the lightweight fabric!
(The crispy-textured fabric keeps you cool even when wet, and if you wet it on hot days before dressing your pup, they feel less hot. But this usually adds weight to the clothes - with this material it's so light that it doesn't change, which is great - ☝🏻)
Finishing quality 👍👍

#SSFW Clothing Drawback
The clothes are thin and light, which is good, but I'm slightly worried the side snaps might get damaged if pulled with force ㅎ

#Winner of Test Experience
I was so happy and excited to win clothes from such a good brand~!
Our pup doesn't feel uncomfortable wearing this brand's clothes, so I was very satisfied every time I dressed her. Getting such a great opportunity to write this review made me participate even more sincerely~🤗 Because of this, writing the review itself wasn't burdensome, which was nice~!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
몸무게 6.4kg.가슴둘레 48cm의 옷입기 싫어하는 비숑남아 입니다.
사이즈조견표보고 L 받아 입혀봤는데
오늘 미용을했음에도 똑딱이 두개다 닫으니 쫄티가되요~🤣🤣
하지만,한쪽만 똑딱이를 바깥쪽 한개만 닫으면 여유있게 잘맞아서 털이찌면 사이즈조절이 가능해지고.
가슴쪽도 길게내려오거나 밴드가 있어 조이지않으니 아이도 불편하지않아하고,산책중 마킹해도 옷에 묻을일도 없고.
원단도 얇고,부들부들~ 여름에 입히기 좋은거같아요.
사실,비숑이라 카라나 모자를 선호하지않는데,모자도 흔들리지말라고 똑딱이로 고정할수 있으니  만드신분의 센스가 느껴져요.
좋은기회로 예쁘고 편한옷을 입힐수 있어 너~무 좋아요.😍😍
#체험단
reviews.content_en:
My Bichon boy weighs 6.4kg with a 48cm chest circumference and hates wearing clothes. I checked the size chart and got a size L, and even after grooming today, closing both snaps makes it too tight~🤣🤣 But if I only close one snap on one side, it fits comfortably with plenty of room, and when his fur grows in, the size becomes adjustable. The chest area comes down long or has bands that don't squeeze, so he's not uncomfortable. Even if he marks during walks, it doesn't get on the clothes. The fabric is thin and so soft~ it seems perfect for summer. Actually, since he's a Bichon, he doesn't usually like collars or hats, but the fact that the hat can be secured with snaps so it doesn't shake shows great sense from whoever made this. I'm so happy to have a pretty and comfortable outfit for him with this great opportunity.😍😍
#TestExperience

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
한여름에 입혀도 부담없을 얇은 시스루에 후들후들한 소재예요! 자외선 차단 겸 진드기 대비 여름에도 얇은 옷을 입히는 편인데 가지고 있는 가벼운 옷 중에 제일 맘에 들어용!

산책좋아옷입긴싫어강쥐인데 머리만 쏙 넣어서 스냅 단추로 마무리하면 끝이라 간편해요! 자외선으로부터 피부 보호해주면서 귀여움까지 따블로 챙길 수 있는 에쎕떱:) 

좋은 기회로 좋은 제품 체험했는데 넘넘 만족스러워용 오자마자 입히고 산책했는데 다른 색상도 구매하고 싶을 만큼! 최고최고!! #체험단
reviews.content_en:
It's a thin see-through material with a fluttery fabric that's no burden even in the height of summer! Since I put on light clothes in summer anyway for UV protection and tick prevention, this is my favorite among the lightweight clothes I have!

My pup loves walks but hates wearing clothes, and with just the head poking through and snaps to finish, it's so convenient! It protects the skin from UV rays while also being cute - a double win :) I had a great opportunity to try out a great product and I'm so satisfied! As soon as it arrived, I put it on her and went for a walk, and I want to buy other colors too! The best best!! #TestExperience

reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
소재도 하늘하늘하니 여름에 딱 좋은 소재고 너무 귀엽더라구요 모자까지 달려서 하네스 고리 구멍도 있어서 편해요 옷 입히고 하네스하면 옷입은티도 잘 안나고 그런데 이런 디테일이 좋아요 3.3kg인데 허리가 30 좀 넘어서 L사이즈 시켰는데 사이즈 선택도 좋았던거 같아용 ㅎㅎ 베이지색이라 그런지 얼굴 확 사는 느낌 이번여름에 잘입고 다닐거 같고 아가도 옷 입을때 편해해요
#체험단
reviews.content_en:
The fabric is so airy and perfect for summer, and it's so cute! It comes with a hat and has a harness ring hole, so it's convenient. When you put on the outfit and then the harness, the outfit isn't too visible, and I love these details. My pup weighs 3.3kg and her waist is a bit over 30, so I ordered size L and it was a good choice ㅎㅎ Because it's beige, her face really stands out. I think she'll wear it well this summer, and she finds it convenient to put on too
#TestExperience

잘맞아여 요즘벌써 진드기가 난리더라구여

reviews.content: 하늘색 사고 핑크도 샀어요. 여름에 가볍게 입히기 좋을 것 같아요.
reviews.content_en: I bought the sky blue and also got the pink. It seems perfect for lightweight wear in the summer.

reviews.content_en: It's very cute, thin, easy to put on, and has a harness hole. I'm satisfied! In the summer it's great for blocking sunlight and blocking AC drafts.

It's a thin see-through material with a fluttery fabric that's no burden even in the height of summer! Since I put on light clothes in summer anyway for UV protection and tick prevention, this is my favorite among the lightweight clothes I have!

reviews.content_en:
Dog weight: 3.5-3.6kg
Dog's usual size: M or L (for tighter-fitting clothes)

#SSFW Clothing Advantages
Incredible attention to detail! (Snaps are embroidered on the hat and back so the hat doesn't rattle and stays perfectly fixed to the outfit without disrupting the fit - 🫶🏼)
Clean design!
(The colors are great because they're never too bold! The subtle tones are nice, and I'm satisfied with the uncluttered, clean design~)
Most importantly, the lightweight fabric!
(The crispy-textured fabric keeps you cool even when wet, and if you wet it on hot days before dressing your pup, they feel less hot. But this usually adds weight to the clothes - with this material it's so light that it doesn't change, which is great - ☝🏻)
Finishing quality 👍👍

#SSFW Clothing Drawback
The clothes are thin and light, which is good, but I'm slightly worried the side snaps might get damaged if pulled with force ㅎ

#Winner of Test Experience
I was so happy and excited to win clothes from such a good brand~!
Our pup doesn't feel uncomfortable wearing this brand's clothes, so I was very satisfied every time I dressed her. Getting such a great opportunity to write this review made me participate even more sincerely~🤗 Because of this, writing the review itself wasn't burdensome, which was nice~!

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
강아지 몸무게 3.5-3.6
강아지 평소 옷사이즈 M or L(타이트하게 나온 옷의 경우)

#SSFW 옷의 장점
극강의 세심함! (모자와 등부분에 똑딱이 단추를 수놓아서 모자가 덜컹이지 않고 딱 옷에 고정되어 핏을 흐트러뜨리지 않는 세심한 배려-🫶🏼)
깔끔한 디자인!
(색상이 무엇보다 무조건적으로 튀지않아서 좋아요! 은은한 톤으로 만들어진 색상도 좋고~ 군더더기없는 깔끔한 디자인도 만족스러워요~) 
무엇보다 좋은 것은, 가벼운 소재의 옷 재질!
(사각거리는 소재의 옷이라 물을 적셔도 시원함이 오래 유지되고, 더울때 옷을 적셔놓고 입히면 덜 더워하는데 그렇게 입히면 옷이 무게가 더해질 수 있지만, 이 소재는 기본적으로 가볍기 때문에 변화가 없어서 좋다-☝🏻)
마감 퀄리티👍👍

#SSFW 옷의 아쉬운 점
옷이 얇아서 가볍고 좋지만, 옆구리쪽 똑딱이 단추로 힘줘서 당기면 손상이 갈까봐 살짝 염려됩니당 ㅎ

#체험단 당첨 
좋은 브랜드의 옷을 당첨받아서 매우 기분좋고 설렜어요~!
우리 똥강아지가 이 브랜드의 옷을 입으면 불편해하지 않아서
입힐때마다 만족도가 상당히 높았었는데 이렇게 좋은 기회를 얻게 되어 리뷰할 수 있어서 더욱 더 진심으로 참여하게 되었어요~🤗 그래서인지 리뷰참여 자체가 부담되지 않아서 좋았어요~!
reviews.content_en:
My Bichon boy weighs 6.4kg with a 48cm chest circumference and hates wearing clothes. I checked the size chart and got a size L, and even after grooming today, closing both snaps makes it too tight~🤣🤣 But if I only close one snap on one side, it fits comfortably with plenty of room, and when his fur grows in, the size becomes adjustable. The chest area comes down long or has bands that don't squeeze, so he's not uncomfortable. Even if he marks during walks, it doesn't get on the clothes. The fabric is thin and so soft~ it seems perfect for summer. Actually, since he's a Bichon, he doesn't usually like collars or hats, but the fact that the hat can be secured with snaps so it doesn't shake shows great sense from whoever made this. I'm so happy to have a pretty and comfortable outfit for him with this great opportunity.😍😍
#TestExperience
